name: mirage
text: Bids max: built (v1.0.19, release building now): Bids tab > Advanced has 'Most the bids up may be worth (of the wallet)' with 100 / 200 / 300 / 400% chips and a box to type any percent. It applies on the phone and the engine. Caveat: Novig holds no cash behind a resting bid, so if many fill at once beyond your cash, later ones get refused. Live totals bids: good idea, and you've now asked for it (live bids were pregame-only until your word). It needs a live model of the total from score and time left; I've written it up as CH42 and will research the model before posting any live bid, since live orders are real money. Also in v1.0.19: an API with refused keys is no longer green, and Check key now says Checking... then the result.
